result: Recount worker-ladder escalation codes after the 2026-10-11 fixes and compare with the baseline (111 MODEL_ESCALATED, 68 CONTENT_VALIDATION_FAILED)
evidence: Recount 2026-11-24 from state.json of the 334 clips in the instance needs-claude bucket updated 2026-10-12..2026-11-23 (the bucket is clips/clips/needs-claude in the data instance, not clips-inbox): AUTO_REVIEWER_ESCALATED 170 (baseline 16), CONTENT_VALIDATION_FAILED 85 (68), MODEL_ESCALATED 79 (111). 125 of the reviewer escalations are the same-tier verdict discard that the review-gate fix of 2026-11-24 removes. Section-dropping rewrites are still 63 (baseline 44), so the single retry of 480c77d did not reduce them. Selection-pass escalations for a missing page no longer appear; MODEL_ESCALATED is now refused page writes (written twice, new page naming an unseen link target). Caveat: updatedAt moves on retry, so the two windows differ in length and population; counts, not rates.
